workarounds.title: Scilab isdef one-argument initialization
workarounds.trigger: Initializing global observability arrays during module load.
workarounds.consequence: Global variables are declared first and isdef is called with one argument.
workarounds.removal_criteria: Retire only after all supported Scilab versions are verified to accept a replacement form and startup regression passes.

workarounds.title: ASCII numeric payload row normalization
workarounds.trigger: Scilab emits or receives ASCII numeric vectors whose orientation may vary.
workarounds.consequence: Numeric byte arrays are normalized to one row before bridge transport.
workarounds.removal_criteria: Retire only after bidirectional transport qualification proves orientation-independent behavior for every supported Scilab/JCEF pair.

workarounds.title: Committed diagnostic-directory fallback

deployment: environments without a validated ZIP helper

workarounds.trigger: A safe, deployment-wide ZIP creation helper is not guaranteed.
workarounds.consequence: Diagnostic export commits a self-describing directory with package_manifest.json and PACKAGE_COMPLETE instead of an archive.
workarounds.removal_criteria: Retire when a ZIP helper is packaged, offline, cross-platform, integrity-tested, and qualified on every supported environment.

workarounds.title: Optional Windows PowerShell process-memory sampling
workarounds.trigger: Native process working-set/private-byte metrics are requested.
workarounds.consequence: PowerShell Get-Process is used when available; otherwise metrics report supported=false and the plot operation continues.
workarounds.removal_criteria: Retire when Scilab exposes a qualified cross-platform process-memory API or a packaged local helper replaces PowerShell.

workarounds.title: Numeric-keyed JCEF callback object summarization
workarounds.trigger: Bridge numeric collections arrive as objects with sequential numeric property names rather than JavaScript arrays.
workarounds.consequence: The payload summarizer recognizes sequential numeric keys and records count, estimated bytes, and a bounded sample without dumping all values.
workarounds.removal_criteria: Retire only after every supported JCEF bridge returns qualified native arrays or typed arrays for these callbacks.
